name: ai-sdlc
description: Vibe coding for developers on the AI-native SDLC playbook. Ideas become a committed intent → design → spec → plan → verified build → independent review → gated ship chain. Runs on a Claude subscription (no API key). Opinionated stacks (Nuxt/Next on Cloudflare, BFF + Go/Postgres, Flutter, Tauri), risk-tiered ceremony and model routing, deterministic hooks (plan gate, test lock, secrets, production gate, verify-before-done), and a closed maintenance loop.
